title: Four Sleeper sprites incorporate individualized Echo Frame visual traits without changing portrait identity
summary: Founder clarified that the four approved portrait-matched playable Sleeper designs must also show Echo-related ancient-tech characteristics: meaningful armor wear and age, exposed joints/cables, torn fabric, selective corrosion or overgrowth, independent sentient display/memory glitches and later controlled actuator stutters. Preserve four original selection portraits and one-to-one corresponding sprites with distinct A violet neutral, B damaged scarf violet, C ponytail violet and D cyan worn identifiers. Treat Echo-style cues as deliberate layering on the existing approved look, NOT a new claim that the Sleeper starters are literally Echo Frames; do not blanket-damage or merge identities. Finish/validate 4-view static sprite construction before visual glitch/walk animations and Android engine save/selection testing. No private artwork uploaded publicly.
